# CleanMyCSV - Automated CSV Data Cleaner & Normalizer

> CleanMyCSV (https://cleanmycsv.fr) is a web application that automatically repairs, cleans, standardizes, and secures corrupted or poorly formatted CSV files in seconds.

## Core Capabilities
- **Encoding Fix:** Automatic conversion of legacy encodings (Windows-1252, MacRoman) to standard UTF-8 BOM, fixing broken accents (e.g., "Ã©" -> "é").
- **Separator Detection:** Auto-detects delimiters (semicolon `;`, comma `,`, tab `\t`, pipe `|`) and prevents column shifts.
- **Postal Code Repair:** Restores missing leading zeros stripped by Microsoft Excel for French (06100) and US ZIP codes (02110 / ZIP+4).
- **International Phone Standardization:** Cleans special characters, removes internal extension duplicates, converts local numbers to E.164 / standard formats (+33 / +1), with built-in Anti-ID protection (preserves SIRET, EAN barcodes > 13 digits).
- **Financial & Currency Extraction:** Extracts currency symbols (€, $, £, CAD, USD) into dedicated columns and converts amounts into pure decimal floats.
- **Date Standardization:** Converts mixed, text, or Excel serial dates (e.g. 45292) to ISO 8601 (`YYYY-MM-DD`).
- **Security & Sanitization:** Neutralizes CSV Injection / Formula Injections (`=`, `+`, `-`, `@`) to prevent XSS and malicious execution in CRMs.
- **Deduplication & Cleanup:** Removes 100% duplicate rows and empty rows.

## Regional Cleaning Modes
- **FR / Europe Mode:** Interprets comma `,` as decimal separator, semicolon `;` as column delimiter, DD/MM/YYYY dates, and +33 phone formatting.
- **US / International Mode:** Interprets dot `.` as decimal separator, comma `,` as column delimiter, MM/DD/YYYY dates, and US ZIP+4 formatting.
